metadata.title: Hermitian manifolds with constant holomorphic sectional curvature or real bisectional curvature
metadata.abstract: An old conjecture in Hermitian geometry states that a compact Hermitian manifold with constant holomorphic sectional curvature is Kähler when the constant is nonzero and Chern flat when the constant is zero. Yang--Zheng introduced the real bisectional curvature as a generalization of the holomorphic sectional curvature and conjectured that, a compact Hermitian manifold with constant real bisectional curvature has zero constant and is Chern flat. They proved that the constant cannot be positive. In this paper, we first prove their conjecture. For a negative constant, we show that the metric is pluriclosed and use comparison with a negative Kähler--Einstein metric to obtain a contradiction. For the zero constant, we combine a torsion identity of Lin--Ren with the Bochner formula of Zhou--Zheng to prove Chern flatness. We also prove that a pluriclosed metric with constant negative holomorphic sectional curvature on a compact Kähler manifold is Kähler.

analysis.workSummary: 作者证明常实双截曲率的紧 Hermitian 流形必须该曲率为零且 Chern 平坦。
analysis.breakthrough: 若证明成立，将解决摘要所述 Yang–Zheng 猜想，并得到另一带 pluriclosed 条件的刚性结果。
analysis.limitations: 实双截曲率、全纯截面曲率和不同联络曲率不能混淆；另一结果还依赖额外背景条件。仅依据官方英文摘要及作者评论，尚未核查正文与完整证明；技术说明仅限摘要明确的信息，关键结论需回查原文。AI 披露另见独立核查记录；未检索到声明不代表没有使用 AI。
analysis.aiEvidence: 作者明确披露使用 ChatGPT Plus 作为辅助工具，并声明由作者完成和验证数学内容；声明未逐项细分工具贡献。

analysis.priorityReason: 非 Kähler 曲率刚性的重要命题，优先查明消失步骤与既有挠率结果的衔接。
